name: What factors influence the property value of a custom-built home?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the property value of a custom-built home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence the property value of a custom-built home, including location, size, quality of construction, architectural design, and the rarity of unique features. High-quality materials, energy-efficient systems, and desirable amenities often contribute to a higher appraisal. Additionally, the condition of the home, landscaping, and the overall market demand in areas like Beverly Hills or Pasadena can significantly impact its resale value. We focus on durable construction and thoughtful design to enhance long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property value of a custom home is influenced by location, size, construction quality, design, unique features, and market demand in specific areas.
